nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Repository guidance for agents covering GitHub issue tracking, canonical triage labels, domain documentation, and the requirement to write docstrings during coding.

nodes.name: CONTEXT.md
nodes.summary: Domain context for the Software Factory, defining the supervised run model and its key concepts, including checkpoints, gates, workers, harnesses, reports, credentials, and operational storage.

nodes.name: factory.yaml
nodes.summary: Checked-in repository configuration defining the main branch, Go setup command, ordered format/vet/test/build gates, harness and model defaults, timeouts, retry limits, test policy, worker image, and base synchronization mode.
nodes.languageNotes: YAML expresses a dependency-ordered deterministic gate pipeline and separate policy sections for harnesses, models, retries, and worker builds.

nodes.name: go.mod
nodes.summary: Go module manifest declaring the github.com/Stevie1704/sw-factory module, Go 1.25.0, and its direct and indirect dependencies for UUIDs, system calls, YAML, and SQLite support.
nodes.languageNotes: The manifest separates direct requirements from indirect dependencies in two require blocks.

nodes.name: go.sum
nodes.summary: Go module checksum database recording cryptographic hashes for the project’s direct and transitive module versions and their go.mod files.
nodes.languageNotes: Entries include both module-content and module-go.mod hashes, supporting reproducible and verified dependency downloads.
